name: Prusa / Marlin
startScript:
G28 ; home all axes
M104 S{hotendTemp:.0f} ; set hotend
M140 S{bedTemp:.0f} ; set bed
M109 S{hotendTemp:.0f} ; wait for hotend
M190 S{bedTemp:.0f} ; wait for bed
G92 E0 ; reset extruder
endScript:
M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M107 ; fan off
G1 Z{parkZ:.3f} F600 ; lift
G28 X Y ; home XY
M84 ; motors off
